domain: the vicfei dsh plugin family: multi-agent investment committees, quant research plugins, semantic layers, ontology construction for DeepSeek Harness

entity_types.name: compaction_judge
entity_types.desc: The calibrated semantic judge that decides which context to keep verbatim or drop, replacing character-count pruning.

entity_types.name: dissent
entity_types.desc: A recorded, never-deleted objection from a persona that the PM must name if unrebutted.

entity_types.name: dsh_plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin repository in the vicfei family, providing a packaged capability such as an investment committee, market-data bridge, or ontology builder.

entity_types.name: entity
entity_types.desc: A typed node in a constructed ontology, carrying its source quote.

entity_types.name: evidence_tag
entity_types.desc: A source quote or citation attached to a claim, entity, or relation; assertions without evidence are disallowed.

entity_types.name: exchange
entity_types.desc: A crypto trading venue accessed through the CCXT bridge, identified on every payload.

entity_types.name: ic_memo
entity_types.desc: The auditable open-format investment-committee memo produced as plugin output.

entity_types.name: investor_persona
entity_types.desc: A named investor-legend agent (Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Wood) that independently values a ticker within the hedge-fund committee.

entity_types.name: market_data_payload
entity_types.desc: A read-only market-data record carrying its exchange and timestamp.

entity_types.name: ontology
entity_types.desc: A typed TBox+ABox artifact produced by the auto-ontology plugin, with evidence-linked entities and relations.

entity_types.name: portfolio_manager
entity_types.desc: The aggregating agent role that combines persona verdicts, names the deciding driver, and records dissent.

entity_types.name: relation
entity_types.desc: A typed edge between ontology entities, carrying its source quote.

entity_types.name: tool_result
entity_types.desc: A tool output subject to compaction, retained verbatim or dropped by the judge.

entity_types.name: trading_guard
entity_types.desc: A fail-closed code-level safeguard (triple unlock, notional caps, symbol whitelist) that the LLM cannot bypass.

entity_types.name: type_conflict
entity_types.desc: An organically detected conflict between ontology types, flagged rather than silently dropped.

entity_types.name: upstream_project
entity_types.desc: An external open-source project (e.g. ccxt, NVIDIA auto-ontology, virattt/ai-hedge-fund) that a dsh plugin is inspired by or built on, explicitly not affiliated.

entity_types.name: verdict
entity_types.desc: A committee decision on a ticker, including PASS/abstention as a first-class outcome.

relation_types.name: inspired_by
relation_types.desc: A dsh plugin is modeled on or derives its concept from an upstream project without sharing code.

relation_types.name: sister_project_of
relation_types.desc: Two plugins belong to the same vicfei family and cross-reference each other.

relation_types.name: has_persona
relation_types.desc: The hedge-fund plugin runs the given investor persona as an independent valuer.

relation_types.name: aggregates_verdicts
relation_types.desc: The PM combines independent persona valuations into a single committee verdict.

relation_types.name: records_dissent
relation_types.desc: The PM records objections rather than deleting them.

relation_types.name: supports_verdict
relation_types.desc: An evidence tag backs a claim or verdict.

relation_types.name: produces_output
relation_types.desc: The hedge-fund plugin emits an IC-MEMO as its auditable output.

relation_types.name: constructs_ontology
relation_types.desc: The auto-ontology plugin builds a typed ontology from documents.

relation_types.name: contains_relation
relation_types.desc: An ontology includes typed relations between entities.

relation_types.name: has_evidence
relation_types.desc: An ontology entity carries its source quote as evidence.

relation_types.name: has_evidence
relation_types.desc: An ontology relation carries its source quote as evidence.

relation_types.name: flags_conflict
relation_types.desc: The ontology surfaces detected type conflicts instead of dropping them.

relation_types.name: bridges_exchange
relation_types.desc: The CCXT plugin exposes exchanges as DSH tools.

relation_types.name: carries_provenance
relation_types.desc: A market-data payload identifies the exchange and timestamp it came from.

relation_types.name: guards_trading
relation_types.desc: The guard enforces fail-closed order restrictions in bridge code.

relation_types.name: compacts
relation_types.desc: The judge decides which tool-result content to keep verbatim or drop.
